value.signature: fn replay_local (p : & Procedure , input : & VerificationInput , candidate : & [Range] , residual : & TwoMapRecord , declaration : & LocalDeclaration , record : & LocalRecord ,) -> Result < LocalRecord , Error >

review.body: { replay_two_map (p , input , candidate , residual) ? ; run (p , input , residual , declaration , Some (record)) }
review.item_premise: Only public rational declarations, ordered boxes and bounded scalar evidence are consumed and returned. Replay reconstructs mathematical questions; no secret or authenticated publication input is admitted.
